meta.title: Disability types and impairments
meta.note: The published FRS summary gives the three most commonly reported impairment types for each age group. People can report more than one impairment, so percentages can overlap.

definitions.label: Mobility
definitions.text: Difficulties with moving around, walking or getting from place to place.

definitions.label: Stamina, breathing or fatigue
definitions.text: Long-term difficulties with energy, breathing, stamina or fatigue that affect everyday activities.

definitions.label: Dexterity
definitions.text: Difficulties using hands or fingers for everyday tasks.

definitions.label: Learning
definitions.text: Difficulties with learning, understanding or processing information.

definitions.label: Mental health
definitions.text: Long-term mental health difficulties that substantially affect everyday activities.

definitions.label: Social or behavioural
definitions.text: Long-term social or behavioural difficulties that substantially affect everyday activities.

definitions.label: Communication
definitions.text: Difficulties communicating, speaking or being understood.

definitions.label: Other / multiple impairments
definitions.text: Some people have an impairment not captured by a single broad label, or report more than one impairment.
